content: better-auth latest is 1.6.23 (npm). magicLink plugin: import magicLink from better-auth/plugins server-side + magicLinkClient from better-auth/client/plugins; configure sendMagicLink callback. Fastify integration: catch-all route /api/auth/* converting Fastify req to a Fetch API Request via fromNodeHeaders, passed to auth.handler(req); response streamed back via reply.header/status/send. Session retrieval via auth.api.getSession({headers: fromNodeHeaders(request.headers)}). Generic OIDC: two options — genericOAuth plugin (manual per-provider config incl. discoveryUrl, requireIssuerValidation recommended) or the dedicated sso plugin which auto-discovers IdP endpoints from issuer + '.well-known/openid-configuration', registers callback at /sso/callback/:providerId (or shared /sso/callback), and requires / after adding. Prisma adapter: import { prismaAdapter } from 'better-auth/adapters/prisma' (built into core package, not separate), pass PrismaClient + provider name.
